# Support

This repository is a community template, maintained in spare time.

- **Before opening an issue:** run the gates on a clean checkout
  (`npm ci && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck`)
  and include the failing output.
- **Architecture questions:** read [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
  and the [ADRs](../docs/adr/README.md) first; propose a new ADR to change one.
- **Security issues:** do not open a public issue — see
  [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
- **No paid support exists.** There is no SLA on responses. Treat suggestions
  as best-effort.
